name: Florian, Voldaren Scion
oracle_text:
First strike
At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the total amount of life your opponents lost this turn. Exile one of those cards and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may play the exiled card this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the total amount of life your opponents lost this turn. Exile one of those cards and put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. You may play the exiled card this turn.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires at the beginning of each postcombat main phase of the controller's turn -- i.e. the engine's turn structure must emit a distinct main-phase-two beginning event, scoped to 'your' turns, and fire it on every such phase rather than once per turn (extra combat phases give extra postcombat mains)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events carries phase-boundary events for upkeep, draw_step, begin_combat and end_step only. begin_combat is the nearest phase event but fires before combat, not after it, so a card hung on it would read life lost before combat damage -- exactly the value this card is meant to see. There is no main-phase event of either kind, and no way to say 'each of your' as opposed to 'once on your turn'.

needs.what: an effect that exiles a card and grants its controller permission to play (cast, or put down as a land) that specific exiled card until end of turn -- the 'impulse draw' pattern. Needs the exiled card tracked as a playable object with a duration, and the play-legality check taught to consult that grant
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ops has `exile`, which moves the card and stops; nothing grants permission to play a card from exile. The `exiled_with` selector can find cards a source exiled, but selectors only feed effects' `objects`, so it can address the card without making it playable. The `play_lands_from_graveyard` / `play_lands_from_library_top` static_effects are the closest permission-granting things in the vocabulary, and they cover the wrong zone, are lands-only, and are permanent statics rather than a per-card until-end-of-turn grant. Substituting `draw` or `return_to_hand` would be an approximation: it changes card advantage, dodges the this-turn deadline, and makes the card unplayable-from-exile text vanish.

needs.what: a disposition for looked-at/revealed cards that puts the unchosen remainder on the bottom of the library in a random order, as a sibling of the existing put-on-top behaviour
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ops has `put_on_top` and `shuffle`, but nothing that addresses the bottom of the library, and shuffling the whole library is a different game action (it would also reorder the rest of the deck, which matters to any other effect that set up the top). `look_at_top` selects cards to look at but there is no stated bottom-in-random-order remainder disposition to pair it with.
